name: audit_activity_scan_rollup
description: Snowdrop-favorable scan-heavy activity dashboard over the largest append-style fact table.
sql: SELECT event_day, event_kind, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM audit_events GROUP BY event_day, event_kind ORDER BY event_day, event_kind LIMIT 60;

name: orders_status_count_scan
description: Single-table status distribution over order facts with low-cardinality grouping.
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status;

name: tickets_status_scan
description: High-row-count status distribution over tickets without join materialization.
sql: SELECT ticket_status, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM tickets GROUP BY ticket_status ORDER BY ticket_status;

name: payments_status_count_scan
description: Payment fact status distribution using a compact projection.
sql: SELECT payment_status, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments GROUP BY payment_status ORDER BY payment_status;

name: seat_hold_status_scan
description: Operational hold-state dashboard over a focused fact-like table.
sql: SELECT hold_status, COUNT(*) AS hold_count FROM seat_holds GROUP BY hold_status ORDER BY hold_status;
